nm QUALITY OF EARNINGS Q3 2026 net income 283.3M includes other income 27.5M (interest on 3.0B cash and securities) and tax of only 5.8M (2.0% rate: US losses/valuation allowance; FY2025 tax was a net benefit of 1.0M after the valuation-allowance release). Operating income 261.6M (29% margin, GAAP after 131.3M SBC = 14.7% of revenue; SBC rose from 85.2M in Q4 2025). Repurchases 340.0M in 9M 2026 (Q2 234.6M, Q3 100.4M) vs none in 2025: dilution from SBC is partly offset; basic shares 192.6M vs 188.0M a year earlier. A tax rate will normalize upward: do not capitalize 2% tax.

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic is unavailable (inputs missing). Own check from 10-Q: TTM GAAP operating income (231.828+182.912+231.716+261.586) = 908.0M; invested capital: equity 3,581.7M + lease debt 31.4M - cash and marketable securities 3,033.4M = 579.7M operating capital, so NOPAT (21% tax, 717M) / operating capital = ~124% (essentially an asset-light business whose capital is its cash pile). On total capital incl. the 3.0B of cash and securities (3,613M) ROIC is ~20%. Goodwill 42.2M, intangibles 10.1M, receivables 730.1M (up 40% year on year vs revenue up 53%: no sign of stretched collections). Restricted cash is not material per the balance sheet. Operating leases are inside the 31.4M. Sources pf_10q_20261030, nm_av_statements.

nm CONSENSUS (attributed to Alpha Vantage EARNINGS_ESTIMATES, pulled 2026-11-01; an expectation, not a fact): FY2026 revenue 3,391M (n 31, 3,273-3,521M), EPS 5.39 (n 29, 4.76-6.25); FY2027 revenue 4,477M (n 33, 3,881-4,866M, +32% over FY2026), EPS 7.11 (n 29, 4.35-8.59); Q4 2026 revenue 1,045M (n 26, 947-1,129M), EPS 1.83 (n 23). FY2026 EPS average was 4.98 90 days ago and 5.38 30 days ago, so revisions were up (2 up, 0 down in 30 days). CAUTION: the feed still shows the Q3 2026 revenue estimate as 874.9M (actual 895.0M) and FY2026 totals that equal 9M actual + pre-print Q4, so the rows seem not yet revised for the 2026-10-29 print and 'revisions' lag it; expect Q4 revenue estimates to fall toward the 1,000-1,030M guide. EPS basis not stated by AV (GAAP Q3 actual 1.40 vs estimate 1.33). Consensus FY2027 EPS 7.11 implies P/E 13.0 at 92.20; FY2026 5.39 implies 17.1.

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY low 18.7 median 53.5 high 214.7 now 18.8 years 2025-2026 (trailing P/E on month-end closes with TTM GAAP diluted EPS after SBC, TTM net income / 202M diluted shares; history is short: IPO 2024-03, TTM EPS first positive 2025-Q2, so 2025 values 120-215x are on tiny earnings; since 2026-02 low 18.7 median 40.3 high 55.6). Forward P/E now 17.1 on FY2026 consensus EPS 5.39 and 13.0 on FY2027 7.11 (consensus history not available: forward range cannot be built, a gap). Peak-earnings caution: Q3 2026 EPS 1.40 x 4 = 5.60 is not a run rate to capitalize without the tax normalization (2% tax) and the quarter-on-quarter margin expansion (operating margin 29% vs 10% a year earlier on 53% growth). Sources nm_ib_history, pf_net_income_q_2025_03_31 ... pf_net_income_q_2026_09_30, nm_av_estimates.

nm TRACK RECORD revenue: actual/guided-midpoint ratios Q4'24 1.090, Q1'25 1.075, Q2'25 1.190, Q3'25 1.083, Q4'25 1.099, Q1'26 1.106, Q2'26 1.118, Q3'26 1.035 (8 of 8 guided quarters beat the top of the range; mean about 1.10). Adjusted EBITDA beat the guide midpoint every quarter as well (ratios 1.31, 1.36, 1.39, 1.24, 1.17, 1.24, 1.18, 1.03). The company guides conservatively, but the beat margin on revenue fell to 3.5% in Q3 2026, the smallest in 8 quarters, and the Q4 2026 guide midpoint 1,015M sits below the AV consensus 1,045M: the first time the guide midpoint is under the street. Applying the historical ~1.03-1.10 beat to 1,015M gives ~1,045-1,115M, so the guide itself is not a bearish signal for Q4 revenue; the market reacted to the gap and to deceleration (growth 53% in Q3 vs 61% Q2, 69% Q1). Sources pf_rel_* releases and nm_rel_20241029.
